title: 第11章 被映射的现实第12章 入门了
content_zh:
;;
第四天傍晚。
‘天罡驱邪咒（47）’
很好，又涨了一点。
念诵完天罡驱邪咒，张唯感觉精神尚可，决定出门买点菜。
持续的精神淬炼似乎带来了一些好处，那种深入骨髓的虚弱感和颅内的钝痛确实减轻了些许，让他有了一点出门的轻快。
套上一件洗得发白的t恤，慢慢走下老旧的楼梯。
楼道里光线昏暗，墙皮剥落得厉害，但小区内的绿化很好，空气很清新。
走到一楼单元门口，楼梯口处传来低低的交谈声。
两位头发花白、穿着朴素的老婆婆正坐在自带的小马扎上，一边择着手里刚买的豆角，一边摆着龙门阵。
“……唉，你说现在这些年轻人，压力也真是大，我家小子一提赶紧找对象就要死要活的，弄得我都不敢催促。”
一个老婆婆叹了口气，手里的豆角被她熟练的取丝。
“可不是嘛，年轻人遇一点挫折就寻死觅活的。”
另一个老婆婆接口道，声音带着点唏嘘。
“前些年，就咱们这栋楼，不是还出过那档子事？造孽哟……”
张唯本打算径直走过去，听到咱们这栋楼几个字，脚步下意识地放缓。
“你说的是楼梯间那个？”
第一个老婆婆压低了声音，左右看了看，正好瞥见走近的张唯，便住了口。
张唯心中一动，装作不经意地停下脚步，弯腰系了系其实根本没松的鞋带。
“唉，就是那个租房的女娃。”

第二个老婆婆没太在意张唯，继续道，声音带着惋惜。
“年纪轻轻的，听说是什么……子宫癌？治不好了，家里又没钱，人一下子就垮了。”
“是啊，多好的女娃儿，以前见着还打招呼呢，文文静静的，我还想介绍给我儿子的。”
第一个老婆婆也叹息，“后来就想不开，在楼梯间……唉！”
“吊死的嘛。”
第二个老婆婆声音更低了些，“听我儿子说还什么阔死了个晴天娃娃挂在那里，说什么警察来的时候，那娃娃掉在地上，沾了……唉，不说了不说了，晦气。”
晴天娃娃？
吊死楼梯间？
这几个字眼让他心中一动。
他猛地想起内景世界门外遇到的女鬼。
如果现实世界的房间能在内景世界中映射的话，那么这些事情是否会映射其中？
他强压下心头的震动，直起身，漫步走了过去，尽量用随意的语气询问。
“婆婆，你们说的是几年前的事？那女孩长什么样啊？”
两个老婆婆被他突然的搭话弄得一愣。
第一个老婆婆打量了他一下，看他脸色苍白，身形瘦削，像个病秧子，便也没多想，只当是好奇的邻居。
“哎哟，好几年咯，怕是有……十年了吧？”
她努力回忆着。
“具体哪年记不清了，反正是夏天，热得很。”
“我记得！”
第二个老婆婆突然道：“蜀都报社还报道过，好像是因为家里太困难，唉，社会新闻嘛。

报纸上好像还有她生病时候的照片呢，侧着脸躺在病床上，瘦得脱了形，但看轮廓，以前肯定是个漂亮姑娘。”

In the evening of the fourth day.
‘Tiangang Exorcism Curse (47)’
Very good, it went up a little bit more.
After reciting the Tiangang Exorcism Mantra, Zhang Wei felt that she was in good spirits and decided to go out to buy some food.
The continuous mental tempering seemed to have brought some benefits. The feeling of weakness that penetrated into the bone marrow and the dull pain in the skull did alleviate a little, giving him a little bit of lightness to go out.
Put on a washed-white T-shirt and slowly walked down the old stairs.
The lighting in the corridor is dim and the walls are peeling off badly, but the greening in the community is very good and the air is very fresh.
Walking to the door of the unit on the first floor, low voices of conversation could be heard from the stairs.
Two old ladies with gray hair and plain clothes were sitting on their little horses, choosing the beans they had just bought and arranging the dragon gate array.
"...Sigh, you said these young people nowadays are really under a lot of pressure. My kid is so desperate to find a partner quickly that I don't even dare to rush him."
An old woman sighed, and she deftly shredded the beans in her hand.
"Isn't that right? Young people are looking for death and survival when they encounter a little setback."
Another old woman said, her voice a little sad.
"A few years ago, didn't something like that happen to our building? It was a crime..."
Zhang Wei planned to walk straight over, but when he heard the words "our building", his steps subconsciously slowed down.
"You mean the one in the stairwell?"
The first old woman lowered her voice, looked around, caught a glimpse of Zhang Wei approaching, and stopped talking.
Zhang Wei's heart moved, he pretended to stop casually, bent down and tied his shoelaces which were not loose at all.
"Oh, that's the girl who rents the house."
The second old woman didn't pay much attention to Zhang Wei and continued, her voice filled with regret.
"I'm young. I heard it was... uterine cancer? It can't be cured, and the family has no money, so the person collapses all of a sudden."
"Yes, what a wonderful girl. I greeted her before when I saw her. She was gentle and quiet. I also want to introduce her to my son."
The first old woman also sighed, "Then I couldn't think about it anymore. In the stairwell... ugh!"
"Hang yourself."
The second old woman's voice was even lower, "I heard my son say it's a good thing to have a doll hanging there on a sunny day. When the police came, the doll fell to the ground and got stained... Oh, I won't tell you anymore, it's bad luck."
Sunny day doll?
Hanging in the stairwell?
These words made his heart move.
He suddenly remembered the female ghost he met outside the door of the interior world.
If real-world rooms could be mapped in the interior world, would these things be mapped in them?
He suppressed the shock in his heart, straightened up, strolled over, and tried to ask in a casual tone.
"Mother-in-law, are you talking about a few years ago? What did that girl look like?"
The two old ladies were stunned by his sudden conversation.
The first old woman looked at him and saw that he was pale and thin, like a sickly man, so she didn't think much about it and just regarded him as a curious neighbor.
"Oh, it's been several years. I'm afraid it's been... ten years, right?"
She tried to remember.
"I can't remember exactly which year it was, but it was summer and it was very hot."
"I remember!"
The second old woman suddenly said: "The Shudu newspaper also reported it, it seems that it is because the family is too difficult, alas, it is social news.
There seems to be a photo of her in the newspaper when she was sick. She was lying on the hospital bed with her face sideways. She was so thin that she was out of shape, but judging from her outline, she must have been a beautiful girl before. "
